correctness.rationale: Every scope and quantifier is explicit. The new letter occurs once; deleting it turns the complement of its circular occurrence into UU, preserving exactly the old classes for m<=|U|. Marker windows have a unique rotation beginning with the new letter and correspond to Q_j. Zimin palindromicity identifies Q_j with a ruler prefix followed by the reversal of another ruler prefix. Adjacent equality occurs precisely away from multiples of B=2^v2(m), while for any two distinct blocks a letter at position (d-qprime)B differs due to parity of d. Hence blocks are exactly the equivalence classes. A standalone exhaustive finite checker rederived literal class sets for all n=2..7 and m<=2^(n-1)-1 (10,548 circular starts), fully agreeing. No finite-to-infinite extrapolation is used.
